notes: CombinedTreeProof structures for §9.1, produced by katie's own algorithm implementation. `mutations` describes how the log was built, `owner` is the label owner's state before the update, and `ladder` gives every search key the proof's lookups need — the union of what the owner already held and what the response would add. These carry no UpdateResponse envelope: katie's tree.Update cannot answer any request (see KT-04), so the envelope was never measured and is not claimed. The proof's elements carry no indication of which log entry they belong to; they are in the order §9.1 asks for them.
